sourceVersion: WGS 84 defining ellipsoid a=6378.137 km and 1/f=298.257223563
procedure: For each geodetic latitude, longitude, and ellipsoidal height, the reference evaluates N=a/sqrt(1-e^2 sin^2(latitude)), x=(N+h) cos(latitude) cos(longitude), y=(N+h) cos(latitude) sin(longitude), and z=(N(1-e^2)+h) sin(latitude). Sidereal time is supplied as zero hours so the legacy equatorial result is aligned with ECEF. before records commit ef0ab78, whose implementation incorrectly added height to a before applying the ellipsoid scale factors.
instant: Not time dependent; sidereal time supplied directly as 0 hours
timeScale: No time scale; explicit sidereal angle
frame: Earth-centered Earth-fixed axes, equivalent to legacy equatorial axes at zero sidereal angle
accuracy: Closed-form double-precision WGS 84 reference; before values are a compatibility record, not an accuracy target
